_comment: P186 placement PROPOSAL only; not read by any build. Merge into delta_face.json after agent review (do not edit delta_face.json from a lane).

HERO_GreenCourt_A._pivot_note: Virtual corner where the Delta Road (yaw -71.07) and Sir Mohamed Macan Markar Mw (yaw 17.88) facade lines of OSM way 529639570 meet; hero +X runs along Delta Road. The model assumes a 90 deg corner, the OSM one is 88.95 deg, so the Macan Markar front's far end sits about 1 m off its OSM line (inside the footprint tolerance).

arcade_runs._comment: Survey (P188): the only surviving walk-under arcade on Delta Road is at Kollupitiya, west side, about 6.9095, 79.8502, about 45 m long. Proposed use of the kit pieces: 10 x KIT_Arcade_Colonial_A (45 m) there when the frontage reaches Kollupitiya, plus KIT_Arcade_Colonial_Corner_A wherever a run turns a convex street corner. Not in the vertical slice area; Delta Face Court itself is NOT an arcade (flush shops, recessed corner bay: built into the hero).
